text: 创业板指半日跌1.84%，全市场下跌个股超4300只。 恒指半日跌0.5%，恒生科技指数跌1.1%，天数智芯跌7%，智谱跌超4%。 日本国债收益率全线上行，10年期国债收益率大涨10个基点至1996年以来最高。 报道：谷歌即将发布旗舰人工智能模型Gemini 4。 国家能源局：截至8月底全国累计发电装机容量41.03亿千瓦，同比增长11.1%。
text_en: The ChiNext Index fell 1.84% at midday, with more than 4,300 stocks declining across the market. The Hang Seng Index fell 0.5% at midday, and the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 1.1%, with Iluvatar CoreX down 7% and Zhipu down more than 4%. Japanese government bond yields rose across the board, with the 10-year yield surging 10 basis points to the highest since 1996. Report: Google is about to release its flagship AI model Gemini 4. National Energy Administration: As of the end of August, China's cumulative installed power generation capacity was 4.103 billion kilowatts, up 11.1% year-on-year.
